newsitem.title: USA: Prime Capital completes private placement.
newsitem.headline: Prime Capital completes private placement.

text.p: Prime Capital Corp said Monday it completed the private sale of $5 million of five-year, 12.5 percent subordinated debentures and $2.5 million of nine percent preferred stock to Banc One Capital Corp, a subsidiary of Banc One Corp.

In addition, Banc One Capital has agreed to purchase up to an additional $2.5 million of Prime Capital's five-year 12.5 percent subordinated debentures during the next two years. As part of the transaction, Banc One Capital also received warrants to purchase up to 12 percent of Prime Capital's common stock, depending on the total amount of subordinated debentures purchased by Banc One Capital.
"This additional capital will allow us to continue to implement our plan for growth," said James Friedman, chairman and chief executive officer of Prime Capital, in a statement.
Prime Capital is a large independent, publicly held provider of capital and specialty finance services to health-care and other industries.
Shares of Prime Capital closed at 5-3/8 on October 4.
